      • popCurrentClock

        public static void popCurrentClock(SrcLoc loc)
        Pop the current clock variable. If the clock stack is not empty the previous current clock variable is restored from a stack. if the clock stack is empty the current clock becomes null (no current clock).         loc - is the source file location
